class.name: WaterRippleProbe
class.brief_description: Internal test bridge for the GPU water solver.
class.description: Runs the water solver (ripples and the FFT ocean layer) from a script without a scene node, and reads its height field back, for the module's tests. For games use [PhysXWaterSurface3D]. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal test class of the PhysX module, not a stable API: it may change or be removed without notice.

method.name: clear_sphere
method.description: Removes the sphere that [param owner] submitted with [method submit_sphere].

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets up the ripple simulation: [param grid_resolution] cells per side over [param domain_size] meters, water [param depth], wave [param damping], [param gravity] and the [param water_level] height. Building happens on the render thread; wait for [method is_available].

method.name: configure_ocean
method.description: Sets up the FFT ocean layer: [param ocean_grid_resolution] cells per side over [param ocean_domain_size] meters, with [param wind_speed], [param wind_direction] and [param wave_amplitude]. Call it before the first [method step].

method.name: get_ocean_height_array
method.description: Returns the ocean height field from the last [method refresh_ocean_height_grid].

method.name: get_ocean_imag_array
method.description: Returns the ocean's horizontal (choppy) displacement from the last [method refresh_ocean_height_grid].

method.name: get_ocean_slope_x_array
method.description: Returns the ocean's slope along X from the last [method refresh_ocean_height_grid].

method.name: has_device
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a [RenderingDevice] is available to run the solver on.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] once the solver is configured and ready to [method step]. This can take a frame or two after [method configure].

method.name: refresh_height_grid
method.description: Reads the ripple height field back from the GPU for [method sample_height]. This waits for the GPU.

method.name: refresh_ocean_height_grid
method.description: Reads the ocean layer back from the GPU for the [code]get_ocean_*_array()[/code] methods. This waits for the GPU.

method.name: sample_height
method.description: Returns the water height at the world position ([param world_x], [param world_z]), interpolated from the last [method refresh_height_grid].

method.name: step
method.description: Advances the simulation by [param delta] seconds.

method.name: submit_impulse
method.description: Pushes the water surface once at [param world_pos], over [param radius] meters with [param strength].

method.name: submit_sphere
method.description: Adds or moves a sphere (identified by [param owner]) at [param world_pos] with [param radius] that displaces the water every step with [param strength], like a floating object.
